findings.text: LSA Verification, Ads Launch (LSA+Search), and Meta Retargeting were all due by 2026-08-01 — now 22 days overdue with $0 spend.

GBP actions fell 48% last 7d vs prior 7d; last 3 days (Aug 20–22) show 0 actions vs 9 on Aug 19 — profile visibility sharply declining with no paid support.

suggestions.text: Escalate LSA verification submission immediately — 22-day delay is blocking all Google paid revenue.

Success = LSA dashboard shows 'Under Review' status by that date.
